description: DataCite DOI search (public REST API, no key): DOI, title, publication year, resource type, publisher, creators and landing page for datasets, software and other research outputs. Metadata only. Related tools on this server, for a different need: search_pubmed_article_metadata when you need PubMed article metadata by PMID: title, journal. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
name: search_datacite_metadata
title: DataCite DOI search: DOI, title, publication year, resource
